svg.title: My GitHub numbers
svg.desc: 3,150 contributions (in the past 6 months, on 119 days). 35 days commit streak (my longest ever). 2,624 commits in 33 repos (22 of them private). 14,052 contributions since 2013 (on 1,933 different days)
